title: EC60081: Rf Components And Circuit Design
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Pre-requisites: EC31005Lumped circuit elements at high frequencies. S-matrix
representation. RF components design: Power splitters/combiners, directional
couplers, hybrids, impedance and balun transformers. RF Filter design. RF
mixers, RF amplifier and Oscillator design. Amplifier Noise figure and
Oscillator Phase noise. .RF instruments and measurement techniques. RF
subsystem design.
